intro: Guinea has the world's largest reserves of bauxite, used to make aluminium.

chapters.title: Mining
text: Guinea is one of the biggest bauxite exporters, mostly to China. The giant Simandou iron ore mine began shipping in 2025.

chapters.title: Farming
text: Most people farm rice, cassava and fruit.

keyTerms.meaning: The ore used to make aluminium.
